title: E-Scooter Commute Cost vs Public Transport
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=scooter:trip
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(distance_km) as km, count as trips by _time
| eval scooter_cost=round(km*0.05,2), transit_cost=round(trips*2.5,2), saved=round(transit_cost-scooter_cost,2)
| sort - _time
description: Compares the running cost of your e-scooter commute against what the same trips would cost on public transport.
value: Seeing the monthly saving (or loss) tells you whether the scooter is really cheaper than the bus or train.
implementation: Ingest scooter trips into `index=personal`; estimate cost against a transit fare baseline.
visualization: Column chart of monthly scooter cost versus transit cost.
grandmaExplanation: It compares what your scooter commute costs against taking the bus, showing which is cheaper.
